wardbreaker.name: Wardbreaker
wardbreaker.benefit: Breaking an enemy shield restores {refundSP}% Max SP; once per round.

vengeful_echo.name: Vengeful Echo
vengeful_echo.benefit: Enemy HP damage empowers your next damaging action by {damageBonus}%; once per round, no stacking.

runic_carapace.name: Runic Carapace
runic_carapace.benefit: Completing a paid pathway skill grants a {shieldHP}% Max HP shield; once per round.

cinder_touch.name: Cinder Touch
cinder_touch.benefit: Basic HP hits have a {chance}% chance to apply Burn for {turns} target turns; one attempt per round.

nerve_pin.name: Nerve Pin
nerve_pin.benefit: A critical hit slows its primary target by {slow}% for {turns} target turns; once per round.

merciful_touch.name: Merciful Touch
merciful_touch.benefit: Restoring a teammate’s HP also cleanses one damage-over-time status; once per round.

spiteful_shell.name: Spiteful Shell
spiteful_shell.benefit: An enemy breaking your shield triggers physical retaliation worth {retaliationHP}% Max HP; once per round.

break_the_chain.name: Break the Chain
break_the_chain.benefit: After losing an action to crowd control, cleanse one remaining action-blocking status; once per round.

hunters_opening.name: Hunter's Opening
hunters_opening.benefit: Your first attempted basic attack against each full-HP enemy critically hits if it connects; forced failure still applies.

fractured_moment.name: Fractured Moment
fractured_moment.benefit: After your first successful damaging normal action, take one bonus action; once per battle.

fates_debt.name: Fate's Debt
fates_debt.benefit: Survive one otherwise lethal direct enemy hit at 1 HP; once per battle, excluding executions.
fates_debt.drawback: Lose all SP; healing is blocked through the end of your next scheduled turn.

martyrs_mantle.name: Martyr's Mantle
martyrs_mantle.benefit: Redirect {share}% of teammates’ direct HP damage to yourself, capped at {roundCap}% of your Max HP per round.
martyrs_mantle.drawback: Transferred damage bypasses your defenses and can kill you.

blood_script.name: Blood Script
blood_script.benefit: Paid pathway skills spend HP instead of SP: {hpCost}% Max HP × normal SP cost / Max SP.
blood_script.drawback: Casting must leave at least 1 HP; cooldowns and unlocks still apply.

hollow_saint.name: Hollow Saint
hollow_saint.benefit: All healing you produce becomes shields at {conversion}% value, capped at {roundCap}% recipient Max HP per round.
hollow_saint.drawback: Your healing cannot restore HP; resurrection is unchanged.

unbroken_will.name: Unbroken Will
unbroken_will.benefit: Spend {controlCost}% Max SP to act through Stun, Freeze, Bound, Sleep or Polymorph for this scheduled turn.
unbroken_will.drawback: Insufficient SP leaves control in force; banishment and Madness are unchanged.

lone_sovereign.name: Lone Sovereign
lone_sovereign.benefit: When originally deployed alone, take two normal actions per scheduled turn.
lone_sovereign.drawback: A teammate removes the extra action; becoming the last survivor does not activate it.

unbound_canticle.name: Unbound Canticle
unbound_canticle.benefit: Paid single-target damaging pathway skills hit all eligible foes for {damage}% damage each; utility stays on the primary target.
unbound_canticle.drawback: Converted skills cost {surcharge}% more SP and lose damage against a lone enemy.

spell_eater.name: Spell Eater
spell_eater.benefit: Basic hits burn {drain}% enemy Max SP and heal from actual SP removed, capped at {healCap}% of your Max HP per round.
spell_eater.drawback: Active pathway skills are disabled; zero-SP targets give no drain healing.

chronal_engine.name: Chronal Engine
chronal_engine.benefit: Eligible damaging skills can be reused while cooling down; each remaining turn adds {surcharge}% SP cost.
chronal_engine.drawback: Control, execution, copying, revival, extra-action and signature skills keep normal cooldowns.

spirit_bastion.name: Spirit Bastion
spirit_bastion.benefit: SP absorbs direct enemy HP damage; a full SP pool absorbs {absorption}% Max HP.
spirit_bastion.drawback: Casting spends the same protection resource; executions and indirect damage are excluded.
